spec: §9.2: "Semantic envelope ... every part ends with LF"; "Reference replacement"; "member hash = SHA-256 ... <scc_hash hex>:<decimal index>"
derivation: Hashes independently assembled with Python hashlib from isa=0.8 LF, ptr_width=32 LF, JCS signature LF, canonical function lines LF, and each referenced callee hash LF (§9.2); definitions retain their own name, call references use callee hashes. All references form a DAG; closure and interface hashes coincide. No layout/data/device leaves exist.
